name: sevDesk
description: sevDesk cloud bookkeeping for German SMBs and freelancers: contacts, invoices, vouchers (Belege), orders, parts and bank accounts. REST API v1, API-key auth — the key goes in a bare Authorization header, with no Bearer prefix.
instructions:
**Getting a key**
1. Sign in to sevDesk and open **Einstellungen → Benutzer → (your user) → API-Token**.
2. Copy the token into `SEVDESK_API_KEY`. It belongs to one user in one client (Mandant) and inherits that user's permissions — create a dedicated API user with read rights if the agent should not be able to write.

**The Authorization header has no scheme.** sevDesk expects the raw token (`Authorization: abc123…`), *not* `Bearer abc123…`. This adapter sends it that way; if you build a custom connector against sevDesk by hand, that is the single most common reason for a 401.

**Object names are capitalised and singular**: the collection is `/Contact`, `/Invoice`, `/Voucher`, `/Order`, `/Part` — not `/contacts`. Responses wrap the rows in `{"objects": [...]}`.

**Embedded objects**: most rows reference other objects only by `{id, objectName}`. Pass a comma-separated `embed` (e.g. `embed=contact,contactPerson`) to have sevDesk expand them inline rather than making the agent fetch each one.

**API version**: v1 at `https://my.sevdesk.de/api/v1`. sevDesk has published a v2 preview; v1 remains the supported production surface.

**Writes**: `sevdesk_create_contact` creates a real contact. Invoice creation is deliberately not exposed — sevDesk requires a multi-step create-position-then-book flow whose partial failure leaves an unusable draft, so an invoice is better created in the UI.

**Cloud reachability**: my.sevdesk.de is public with a valid certificate; AnythingMCP Cloud reaches it directly.

tools.name: sevdesk_list_users
tools.description: List the sevDesk users in this client, with their names and e-mail addresses. Fast call with no parameters — use it to confirm the API key is accepted.

tools.name: sevdesk_list_contacts
tools.description: List contacts (customers, suppliers, partners). Narrow by customer number or by depth, and page through larger result sets.

depth.description: `1` also returns the persons (contact persons and private customers); `0` (default) returns organisations only.

customerNumber.description: Exact customer number (Kundennummer) to look up.

embed.description: Comma-separated related objects to expand inline, e.g. addresses,communicationWays.

tools.name: sevdesk_get_contact
tools.description: Read one contact by its numeric sevDesk id, with its category, customer number, tax settings and default payment terms.

embed.description: Comma-separated related objects to expand, e.g. category,parent.

tools.name: sevdesk_list_invoices
tools.description: List outgoing invoices, newest first. Filter by status to answer 'what is unpaid' — status 200 is open, 1000 is paid, 100 is draft.

status.description: Invoice status: 100 draft, 200 open/due, 750 partially paid, 1000 paid, 50 deactivated recurring invoice.

startDate.description: Earliest invoice date as a Unix timestamp in seconds.

endDate.description: Latest invoice date as a Unix timestamp in seconds.

embed.description: Comma-separated related objects to expand, e.g. contact,contactPerson.

tools.name: sevdesk_get_invoice_positions
tools.description: Read the line items (Positionen) of one invoice: article, quantity, unit price, tax rate and the resulting net and gross sums.

tools.name: sevdesk_list_vouchers
tools.description: List vouchers (Belege) — incoming supplier invoices and receipts. This is the bookkeeping side of sevDesk, separate from outgoing invoices.

status.description: Voucher status: 50 draft, 100 unpaid/due, 150 transferred, 750 partially paid, 1000 paid.

startDate.description: Earliest voucher date as a Unix timestamp in seconds.

endDate.description: Latest voucher date as a Unix timestamp in seconds.

embed.description: Comma-separated related objects to expand, e.g. supplier,document.

tools.name: sevdesk_list_orders
tools.description: List orders and quotations (Aufträge und Angebote). The `orderType` field distinguishes AN (Angebot), AB (Auftragsbestätigung) and LI (Lieferschein).

status.description: Order status: 100 draft, 200 delivered, 300 rejected/cancelled, 500 accepted, 750 partially calculated, 1000 calculated.

embed.description: Comma-separated related objects to expand, e.g. contact.

tools.name: sevdesk_list_parts
tools.description: List parts (Artikel) from the sevDesk product catalogue with their price, stock level, unit and tax rate.

partNumber.description: Exact article number to look up.

tools.name: sevdesk_list_check_accounts
tools.description: List the bank and cash accounts (Kassen und Bankkonten) configured in sevDesk, with their current balance and import type.

tools.name: sevdesk_list_transactions
tools.description: List bank transactions on one check account, so unpaid invoices can be matched against money that actually arrived.

checkAccountId.description: Numeric id of the check account, from sevdesk_list_check_accounts.

isBooked.description: true for booked transactions only, false for transactions not yet booked (still to be matched).

tools.name: sevdesk_create_contact
tools.description: Create a new contact (organisation or person). Writes to the live client — search with sevdesk_list_contacts first so a duplicate customer number is not created. Category ids: 3 customer, 2 supplier, 4 partner, 28 prospect.

name.description: Organisation name. Setting it makes the contact an organisation; for a private person leave it empty and use surename and familyname instead.

categoryId.description: Contact category id: 3 = customer, 2 = supplier, 4 = partner, 28 = prospect customer. Required by sevDesk.

customerNumber.description: Customer number. Left blank, sevDesk assigns the next free one.

surename.description: Given name, for a private person.

familyname.description: Family name, for a private person.

description.description: Free-text note stored on the contact.
